It targets the preferences page of the space, which holds its rights: the space has no home page, and ## the administration of a page that doesn't exist displays nothing, while the preferences page is created by the ## administration if needed. #set ($securityEntrySpacePrefsRef = $services.model.createDocumentReference('WebPreferences', $securityEntrySpaceRef)) #set ($securityEntrySpaceRightsURL = $xwiki.getURL($securityEntrySpacePrefsRef, 'admin', 'editor=spaceadmin&section=PageAndChildrenRights')) #set ($securityEntrySpaceRightsLink = ">>path:$services.rendering.escape($securityEntrySpaceRightsURL, 'xwiki/2.1')]]") ## The translation holds the link label between its {0} and {1} parameters. #set ($warningMessage = $services.localization.render('securityadvisoryapplication.home.right.warning', ["__BEGINLINK__", "__ENDLINK__"])) #set ($warningMessage = $services.rendering.escape($warningMessage, "xwiki/2.1")) #set ($warningMessage = $warningMessage.replace($services.rendering.escape("__BEGINLINK__", "xwiki/2.1"), "[[")) #set ($warningMessage = $warningMessage.replace($services.rendering.escape("__ENDLINK__", "xwiki/2.1"), $securityEntrySpaceRightsLink)) {{warning}} $warningMessage {{/warning}} #end #if ($services.security.authorization.hasAccess('admin')) You can import an advisory from Github directly using [[this tool>>.Code.SingleAdvisoryImportPage]]. #end ## The patched versions are stored in the impacted package objects, not in the advisory object: the live table results ## page joins them through the "patchedVersions_class" parameter. Since an advisory can have several impacted packages ## with the same patched version, the "unique" query filter avoids listing the same advisory several times. #set ($impactedPackageClassName = 'SecurityAdvisoryApplication.Code.SecurityAdvisoryImpactedPackageClass') #set ($sourceParameters = $escapetool.url({ 'className': 'SecurityAdvisoryApplication.Code.SecurityAdvisoryApplicationClass', 'translationPrefix': 'securityadvisoryapplication.livetable.', 'resultPage': 'SecurityAdvisoryApplication.Code.AdvisoriesLiveTableResults', 'patchedVersions_class': $impactedPackageClassName, 'queryFilters': 'currentlanguage,hidden,unique' })) ## Suggest the patched versions already used, as the live data does for the list properties of the advisory class. #set ($patchedVersionsSearchURL = "${request.contextPath}/rest/wikis/$escapetool.url($xcontext.database)/classes/") #set ($patchedVersionsSearchURL = "${patchedVersionsSearchURL}$escapetool.url($impactedPackageClassName)") #set ($patchedVersionsSearchURL = "${patchedVersionsSearchURL}/properties/patchedVersions/values?fp={encodedQuery}") ## The CVE identifier is displayed as HTML because the results page renders it as a link to its CVE record. ## Only the disclosed advisories are listed by default, since they are the ones everybody can view: the security team ## removes the status filter to follow the other advisories. ## The status filter is given all the status values as options: the list filter only displays its initial value (here ## the default status filter) when that value is among its options, otherwise the filter looks empty and can't be ## removed. The labels are the ones of the class property, as displayed in the table. See XWIKI-25647: The list filter ## doesn't display a filter value set by the live data configuration when its options come only from a search URL. #set ($statusFilterOptions = []) #set ($advisoryClass = $xwiki.getClass('SecurityAdvisoryApplication.Code.SecurityAdvisoryApplicationClass')) #foreach ($statusEntry in $advisoryClass.get('status').getMapValues().entrySet()) #set ($discard = $statusFilterOptions.add({'value': $statusEntry.key, 'label': $statusEntry.value.value})) #end #set ($liveDataConfig = { 'query': { 'filters': [{'property': 'status', 'constraints': [{'operator': 'equals', 'value': 'DISCLOSED'}]}] }, 'meta': { 'propertyDescriptors': [ {'id': 'status', 'filter': {'options': $statusFilterOptions}}, {'id': 'cveId', 'editable': false, 'displayer': 'html'}, { 'id': 'patchedVersions', 'type': 'StaticList', 'sortable': false, 'editable': false, 'displayer': 'text', 'filter': { 'id': 'list', 'searchURL': $patchedVersionsSearchURL, 'operators': [{'id': 'equals'}, {'id': 'empty'}], 'defaultOperator': 'equals' } } ] } })
